title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — September 18, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B3.2 (Peaked September 17, 2026 at 12:16 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 415 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Quiet conditions out there. 🌎

A broad dark coronal-hole-like area is visible on the Sun’s southern hemisphere; otherwise, the disk looks relatively quiet.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211/193/171 Å Composite
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
